title: First Night Circuit
premise: Lum has the Cathedral online, but the city loop needs one human pass before the night shift can call it alive.

steps.objective: Meet Lum at the Riverwalk beacon.
steps.response: Lum: Good. You made it. The city loop is noisy tonight. Grab the signal shard by the river before we move.

steps.objective: Recover the loose signal shard on the Riverwalk.
steps.response: Signal shard recovered. The Cathedral can hear us again.

steps.objective: Use an in-world gate to reach Lum Coffee House and grab the night-shift coffee.
steps.response: Coffee acquired. Industrial-grade optimism: questionable. Caffeine: confirmed.

steps.objective: Travel to the Cathedral and clear the static-wisp near the nave.
steps.response: Static-wisp dispersed. Whatever that thing was, it has stopped arguing with physics.

steps.objective: Touch the Cathedral lectern and close the first circuit.
steps.response: Circuit closed. Cathedral awake. The city has officially survived one night.

completion.title: First Night Complete
completion.message: Lum: Not bad, Professor. Three districts, one coffee, one electrical ghost, zero apocalypse.
